Keep the shortest fully resolved gradient and raise temperature one step to test whether elution can be accelerated while preserving maximum CRF. Monitor the earliest pair closely because its resolution margin is now only 0.23.

Injection 3 remains the fastest method with maximum CRF. Test the minimum gradient duration with a lower starting organic fraction and lower temperature to help preserve early-pair separation, since warming reduced its resolution.
